original_value: A fictional compact arcade cabinet built for home game rooms, featuring a 14-inch vertical display, dual control panels, configurable light effects, and built-in classic-style rhythm and puzzle collections. Designed as a stand-alone entertainment machine rather than a storage device or graphics card, it targets casual social play and room decor.
